title: Workers AI line reads fully metered when only some attempts were joined
description:
statusWorkerCost returns a sum for any non-empty set of gateway rows. cost.go then marks the whole workers-ai line Metered with basis "AI Gateway logs" and Attempts counting every workers-ai attempt. Failing input: a resumed epic-<id> run with 30 attempts dispatched before metering existed (or while ~/.ticfacrc named no gateway) and 2 after. The line states a measured $X over 32 attempts, and the 30 unmeasured ones are never called "not metered". Related: the join key is just run_id=epic-<id>, so a later re-run of the same epic, or the same epic id in another repo on the same gateway, sums into this run. Also, after 24u, the classifier's own jev calls carry the same run_id. A run with no Workers AI workers then gets a metered "Workers AI $0.0x (0 attempts)" line while the decisions line says not metered.
evidence: internal/cli/status_model.go:415-443; internal/statusmodel/cost.go:130-135

ticfac run epic-hn6 created this tick by absorbing the finding 2bf45933b220fa2b0e9e3a1fc7e52545fff63f0b6560f2c25cceff02cfc0ce7d (reported by run-epic-hn6/tick-pv7/attempt-42): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A4. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/2bf45933b220fa2b0e9e3a1fc7e52545fff63f0b6560f2c25cceff02cfc0ce7d.json on the run branch.
notes: 2026-10-06 01:21 - ticfac run epic-hn6: created by absorbing finding 2bf45933b220fa2b0e9e3a1fc7e52545fff63f0b6560f2c25cceff02cfc0ce7d — placed before the close-out, which does not start while it is open; the review had already run. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/2bf45933b220fa2b0e9e3a1fc7e52545fff63f0b6560f2c25cceff02cfc0ce7d.json on epic/hn6, and it says: the classifier put 0.99 of its probability mass on the items rather than on none, at or above the deliberately cheap absorb threshold of 0.35, and named A4: a false positive costs the epic work it did not need, a false negative closes an epic whose goal is unmet in a factory where nobody is watching, and those are not the same cost — the threshold sits on the cheap side
